summary: ELTAKST SØR AS (org. no. 980 347 362) is a private limited company (AS) based in Arendal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-12-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 74.990 (All annen faglig, vitenskapelig og teknisk virksomhet ikke nevnt annet sted); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 292 802 and net income was NOK 1.1 m. CEO: Odd Inge Johansen; board chair: Børge Neverlien Johansen. Also: LEI 254900ILMAFYQBW3I103.
